Evelyn R. Harper  
evelyn.harper@email.com | 555-321-8765 | LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/evelynrharper | Seattle, WA

Professional Summary  
Results-driven software engineer with over 4 years of experience designing and delivering scalable web applications and services. Skilled at independently managing components of complex projects and collaborating with cross-functional teams to improve system reliability and performance. Recently returned to the workforce following a dedicated family caregiving break and eager to apply strong technical and problem-solving skills in a dynamic engineering team.

Experience  

Software Engineer  
NovaTech Solutions, Seattle, WA  
June 2019 - August 2022  
- Led the development and deployment of a customer analytics dashboard that improved user engagement insights, contributing to a 10% increase in client retention.  
- Independently owned several backend microservices, ensuring 99.9% uptime and improving API response times by approximately 20%.  
- Collaborated with frontend developers and product managers to define and implement new features, streamlining workflows and reducing manual data entry by 30%.  
- Conducted code reviews and mentored junior developers, elevating team coding standards and reducing bugs in production releases.  
- Participated in sprint planning and retrospectives, helping the team to improve delivery predictability.  
- Contributed to migration efforts from legacy monolithic architecture to a cloud-native environment using AWS.

Software Developer  
BrightWave Technologies, Bellevue, WA  
January 2018 - May 2019  
- Worked on a team developing web-based tools for enterprise clients, focusing on backend development with Java and Spring Boot.  
- Implemented RESTful API endpoints and database queries that supported user management and reporting features.  
- Assisted in writing automated test cases, boosting test coverage by roughly 15%.  
- Helped troubleshoot and fix production issues, regularly collaborating with customer support to resolve client problems efficiently.  
- Participated in daily standups and sprint planning, contributing to better estimation and prioritization of tasks.  
- Supported deployment pipelines, occasionally managing staging environments.

Career Break for Family Caregiving  
September 2022 - April 2024  
- Took a planned career pause to provide full-time care and support for family members.  
- Maintained technical skills through online coursework and personal projects, preparing for a return to software engineering.

Junior Software Developer  
ClearPath Innovations, Redmond, WA  
July 2016 - December 2017  
- Assisted in developing internal tools for data processing and reporting using Python and JavaScript.  
- Collaborated with senior engineers to build features that optimized business workflows.  
- Supported QA efforts by creating and executing manual test cases.  
- Engaged in code reviews and team knowledge-sharing sessions.  
- Helped maintain documentation for application APIs and user guides.  

Skills  
- Programming Languages: Java, Python, JavaScript, SQL  
- Frameworks & Tools: Spring Boot, React, AWS (EC2, Lambda), Docker, Jenkins  
- Databases: MySQL, PostgreSQL  
- Practices: RESTful API design, Agile/Scrum, TDD, Continuous Integration/Delivery  
- Version Control: Git, GitHub  
- Strong problem-solving, communication, and project ownership abilities

THE READ

CLARITY SUMMARY: 78/100

Not a prediction of interviews or offers.

Lead with backend reliability results

Several concrete outcomes are visible, with a few uneven areas still limiting the first read.

WHAT LANDS

The NovaTech microservices bullet combines direct ownership with 99.9% uptime and approximately 20% faster API response times, making the backend contribution easy to place.

WHERE DOUBT CREEPS IN

OTHER LINE REWRITES

Useful edits, kept with their own source.

These do not map uniquely to the ranked fixes above, so each stays beside the exact line it rewrites.

LINE EDIT 01 · SOURCE LINE

“- Helped troubleshoot and fix production issues, regularly collaborating with customer support to resolve client problems efficiently.”

REWRITE

Helped troubleshoot and fix production issues for enterprise clients, collaborating with customer support to diagnose [issue type] and coordinate resolution; [resolution time or recurrence measure].

Add one representative incident and its measurable resolution detail to show the difficulty and value of this work.

QUESTIONS WORTH ANSWERING

Prompts for your next revision.

These questions are not tied to a specific ranked fix. Use whichever ones surface a true, useful detail.

QUESTION 01

Why did you choose microservice ownership at NovaTech while contributing to a broader monolith-to-cloud migration?

Why it may help: This would explain how your day-to-day backend work connected to the architecture change.

QUESTION 02

How many services, requests, users, or teams depended on the backend microservices you owned?

Why it may help: The 99.9% uptime result becomes more useful when its operating scale is clear.

QUESTION 03

What production issue did you troubleshoot with customer support, and how did you prevent recurrence?

Why it may help: A specific incident would show judgment beyond routine support participation.

QUESTION 04

What changed in your testing or review process alongside the 15% increase in test coverage?

Why it may help: The coverage number is useful, but the engineering action behind it is not yet visible.

QUESTION 05

What did you personally take from requirements through deployment for the customer analytics dashboard?

Why it may help: The dashboard result is strong; the full delivery path would establish the boundaries of your ownership.

KEEP THESE

The parts already earning trust.
01

The NovaTech microservices bullet combines direct ownership with 99.9% uptime and approximately 20% faster API response times, making the backend contribution easy to place.

02

The dashboard work links development and deployment to a 10% increase in client retention, which gives one project a clear business reason to keep.

03

Java, Spring Boot, AWS, Docker, Jenkins, SQL, and RESTful APIs form a coherent technical base for backend applications.

ROLE DIRECTION

Where this story reads strongest.

Position yourself first as a backend software engineer focused on Java, Spring Boot, APIs, microservices, and AWS. Keep the dashboard and cross-functional delivery results, but make backend ownership the organizing thread.

BEST FIT NOW

Backend Software Engineer
Java Software Engineer
Software Engineer, Cloud Services

Seniority read: Mid-level software engineer, based on the Software Engineer title, microservice ownership, mentoring, and roughly six years of listed experience.
